1030000001201: Goblins keep stealing laundry off my line. Every single sock!
They wear them as hats. Kill ten and teach them some manners.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
My washing line is safe, %player_name%! I'll knit you something.
1030000001301: A snake slithered through the market and swallowed my handbag whole.
Then four more did the same to my friends! Get our five bags back, please.
Our handbags, %player_name%! A bit slimy, but everything's still inside.
1030000001401: I'm a juggler, and I juggle daggers.
I dropped five of them in the long grass, and the snakes coiled around them and won't let go.
Get my daggers back, I've got a show tonight.
All five, %player_name%! Now watch this... ouch. Maybe I'll practise first.
1030000001501: Snakes keep sunbathing on the warm path stones.
Nobody gets past without a bite. Clear ten of them off the road?
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The path is clear, %player_name%! Travellers can walk it again.
1030000001601: Bats fly into my lantern shop every night and smash the glass.
They chase the moths that come to the light. Kill ten bats so I can get some sleep.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Not a single broken lantern last night, %player_name%!
1030000001701: The bell tower is full of bats.
Every time the bell rings, they swarm the whole town. Thin them out, ten should do it.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The bell rang at noon and nobody screamed. Thank you, %player_name%!
1030000001801: I'm a fire mage in training, and pink fireballs are my best work.
The bats think they're glowing fruit and snatch them out of the air.
Bring back five before they set the trees alight.
Five pink fireballs, still burning, %player_name%. Mind your eyebrows.
1030000001901: These skeletons were a king's knights. Each still wears his family's pendant.
My grandmother's is among them. Bring me five, and I'll find hers.
This one has her initials on the back. Thank you, %player_name%.
1030000002001: The old battlefield is waking up. Skeletons in rusted armour are marching again.
Break ten of them before they reach the farms.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The farms are safe, and the battlefield is quiet again, %player_name%.
1030000002101: A necromancer passed through last week and left a mess behind.
The skeletons he raised! He forgot them. Put ten to rest for me.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Ten fewer skeletons wandering about, %player_name%. If he comes back, I'll give him a piece of my mind.
1030000002201: An ogre sat on my cart. Then his friends sat on my house.
Drive off ten of them before they sit on anything else.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
My roof is still a bit flat, but no more ogres, %player_name%!
1030000002301: Ogres robbed the tax collector on the road and took five coin pouches.
Isn't that good news for everyone?
Not when he takes it out of my pay. Get them back!
Five pouches, not a coin missing, %player_name%. My wages are safe.
1030000002401: The theatre's masks have gone missing, and the ogres are wearing them!
They think it makes them look scary. Bring me five, the play opens tomorrow.
The masks are back, %player_name%! They do smell a little of ogre, though.
1030000002501: They took five necklaces from my jewellery stall. Bring them back and I'll give you a discount.
All five, and not a scratch on them, %player_name%!
1030000002601: Eyes have been watching my house all night, every night.
Just watching! It's very creepy. Get rid of ten of them.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
1030000002701: The Eyes keep frightening my sheep, and they won't come out of the barn.
Clear ten away so they can graze again.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The sheep are out in the meadow again, %player_name%. Baa-rilliant!
1030000002801: Rogue wizards are testing spells on the road. Yesterday they turned a merchant into a turnip.
Stop ten of them before they get to me.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The merchant's back to normal, %player_name%. Well, mostly.
1030000002901: Those wizards stole the charm necklaces my village wears to ward off curses.
Without them we're easy targets. Please bring back five.
With the charms back, we can sleep without nightmares, %player_name%.
1030000003001: A wizard duel started in the field last month and never stopped.
They've been blasting each other ever since. End it, defeat ten of them.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Silence at last, %player_name%. The field might even grow grass again.
1030000003101: The Spectres are ghosts of the old scribes, and they've taken my scrolls.
They think they still have work to finish. Bring me back five.
1030000003201: The Spectres here are the ghosts of the old chapel bell-ringers.
They stole the chapel bells, and now they ring them all night long.
So nobody in town can sleep?
Not a wink. Bring me five bells, and the chapel can have them back.
Silence at last, %player_name%! The chapel will ring them properly on Sunday.
1030000003301: Spectres float through my forge and steal the fireballs I light it with.
Cold ghosts love warm things. Bring me five, or my forge goes cold.
The forge is roaring again, %player_name%. I'll make you something sharp.
1030000003401: These aren't ordinary rats. They've grown huge eating the slime in the old sewers.
Ten of them chased the town guard up a tree yesterday. Cull ten for me?
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The guard's finally down from the tree. Thank you, %player_name%!
1030000003501: The royal family's brooches were stolen from the palace.
By rats. They dragged them down the drains. Bring me five.
The queen will wear them at the feast tonight, %player_name%.
1030000003601: I study beetles. The rats here keep rare ones in their nests as snacks.
Bring me five before they get eaten, and I'll name one after you.
Beautiful, %player_name%! I'll call this one the Adventurer Beetle.
1030000003701: Crabs crawled up from the shore and raided my herb shop.
They use my mortars and pestles to crack open shells! Get five back, please.
I can grind my herbs again, %player_name%. The town's potions are saved.
1030000003801: Giant crabs have taken over the beach, and the fishermen can't launch their boats.
Send ten of them back into the sea.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The boats are out on the water again, %player_name%!
1030000003901: My grandmother's bone earrings fell into the rock pools.
The crabs snapped them up and hide them in their shells. Bring me five.
Thank you, %player_name%. Grandmother would be so pleased.
1030000004001: The old sailors buried in the dunes have climbed out of their graves.
Their pipes! They raided the tobacco shop and took five. Get them back.
My pipes, %player_name%! A bit dusty, but they'll do.
1030000004101: A skeleton challenged my son to a duel. He lost, and now they challenge everyone.
Defeat ten of them so they'll stop.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Ten duels won, %player_name%! They'll think twice now.
1030000004201: The skeletons blow wooden horns at night to wake up more of the dead.
Bring me five horns, and they'll have nothing to wake them with.
Five horns, %player_name%. The graveyard will stay quiet tonight.
1030000004301: Goblins have taken over the old fort on the hill.
Take it back. Ten goblins down should break their hold.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Our banner is flying over the fort again, %player_name%!
1030000004401: Goblins trample my crops every night on their way to the river.
Stop ten of them before I lose the whole harvest.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
My fields are safe, %player_name%. Have a basket of turnips!
1030000004501: Goblins guard the bridge and charge everyone a toll.
Bring down ten, and the bridge is free again.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The bridge is free, %player_name%! Traders are already crossing.
1030000004601: I'm an inventor. Snakes got into my workshop and swallowed my gadgets!
Five of them. Get them back before one starts ticking.
1030000004701: The snakes scared every customer away from my inn.
Defeat ten of them, and drinks are on the house.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Customers are back, %player_name%! Your first drink is on me.
1030000004801: The snakes here hunt bats and keep them for later.
My museum wants five for a cave display. Strange, I know.
Five bats, %player_name%! They'll look lovely in a glass case.
1030000004901: My lighthouse went dark when a swarm of bats smashed the lamp.
Defeat ten of them so I can light it again.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The lighthouse is shining again, %player_name%. Ships can find the harbour.
1030000005001: Bats swarm the town walls every night, and the guards can't see a thing.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The guards can see the road again, %player_name%.
1030000005101: Bats flew into the library and carried off the oldest scrolls to line their roosts.
Bring me five scrolls before they're chewed to bits.
The scrolls are back, only a little nibbled, %player_name%.
1030000005201: The iron-boned skeletons gather the bones of the fallen to raise more of their kind.
Bring me five bundles, and I'll bury them where they can't be found.
These bones will rest where no skeleton can find them, %player_name%.
1030000005301: Iron-boned skeletons have cut off the mountain pass. No supplies have reached us in weeks.
Clear ten of them out of the pass.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
The first supply wagon just came through, %player_name%!
1030000005401: My brother went to fight the skeletons in the valley and never came back.
Defeat ten of them, for him.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
Thank you, %player_name%. He'd be proud of you.
1030000005501: The ogre chieftain hides somewhere in this valley, and his ogres guard every path.
Bring down ten, and maybe he'll show himself.
Come back when you've dealt with %count% of them.
His guards are falling, %player_name%. He can't hide much longer.
1030000005601: The ogres stole the town butcher's cleavers.
Ogre-sized toothpicks! Get me five back.
My cleavers, %player_name%! The sausage shop opens tomorrow.
1030000005701: The ogres tore branches from the old elder tree to make their beds.
With five of its golden leaves, I can heal its roots.
Five golden leaves, %player_name%. The old tree will bloom again in spring.
1020000000301: You came over the obsidian bridge? Then you were lucky.
Death Knights patrol that bridge now. They charge a toll in blood from anyone crossing.
No trader has made it across in weeks, and the camp is running out of everything.
Break their patrol. Ten fallen knights should reopen the road.
They ride in pairs along the bridge. Come back when %count% have fallen.
Have %count% %name%s fallen yet? Still no traders on the bridge.
A wagon crossed the bridge this morning, %player_name%! The road is open again.
Tell them the toll's been paid.
1020000000302: Nothing grows on this mountain except my fire pumpkins. They love the hot ash.
But the Eyes have found them. They float down at night and swallow them whole.
They glow brighter after every one. I think the fire inside the pumpkins feeds them.
Get me back five pumpkins, before I've got nothing left to plant next season.
The Eyes that glow brightest have eaten the most. I need %count% pumpkins.
Do you have the %count% %name%s yet? My patch is nearly bare.
Five pumpkins, still warm inside, %player_name%! I'll save the seeds this time.
Maybe build a roof over the patch.
1020000000401: Don't climb any higher without covering your eyes.
The Eyes near the summit stare so hot it burns. Three climbers came back blind with fever this month.
The healers can't keep up, and the summit shrine is cut off.
Bring down ten of them, and maybe the pilgrims can climb again.
Strike fast and don't meet their gaze. Come back after %count%.
Have %count% %name%s been put out yet? Another climber came down burning.
The pilgrims are climbing again, %player_name%. You did what our healers couldn't.
1020000000402: I'm brewing a cooling draught that lets you walk through flame unharmed.
The only thing that makes it work is ash mushrooms. They grow inside old armour, in the heat and dark.
And the only old armour on this mountain is being worn by Death Knights.
So you want me to pick mushrooms off a Death Knight?
Off five of them, yes. Bring me the mushrooms and I'll name the draught after you.
Look in the gaps of their armour. I need %count% clumps.
Do you have the %count% clumps of %name% yet? My cauldron is waiting.
Perfect, %player_name%, grey and smoking! The draught will be ready by morning.
Please don't name it after me.
1020000000801: There's a tomb under these dunes, and something is guarding it.
Skeletons with bones like iron. They were the king's own guard, buried standing up around his tomb.
Now they've marched out, and they cut down anyone who comes near the dunes.
Break ten of them. Their bones are tough, but they're not unbreakable.
Bring a heavy weapon. Come back when %count% of them are in pieces.
Have %count% %name%s been broken yet? I can hear them standing guard.
Ten of the king's guard in pieces, %player_name%! The dunes might finally be safe to cross.
My arms will be sore for a week.
1020000000802: The lost caravan's guards each wore a bronze helmet with their family crest on it.
The families still live in the town. They've never had anything to bury.
The skeletons walking the old road are still wearing those helmets.
So the helmets could finally go home.
That's right. Bring me five, and five families can finally lay their dead to rest.
Look for the crests on the brow. I need %count% helmets.
Do you have the %count% %name%s yet? The families keep asking me.
Five helmets, crests still clear, %player_name%. Five families will light candles tonight.
I'm glad I could help them.
1020000000901: Ever since the Ogres broke into the old tomb, the dead have been getting up.
Hundreds. Every night more skeletons rise around the tomb and wander toward the wells.
We can't drink, we can't sleep, and the children are too scared to go outside.
Put ten of them back down. That should buy us a few quiet nights.
They wander between the tomb and the wells. Come back after %count%.
Have %count% %name%s been put down yet? They were at the wells again last night.
The wells are clear, and the children slept through the night, %player_name%.
1020000000902: The tomb held burial urns with the ashes of the old desert kings.
The Ogres smashed their way in and carried the urns off to use as cooking pots.
Is that why the dead are restless?
Yes. The kings can't rest until their ashes are home, and their soldiers won't either.
Bring back five urns, and I'll return them to the tomb myself.
Please handle them with care. All %count% urns need to go home.
Do you have the %count% %name%s yet? The dead are getting angrier.
Five urns, and I don't think the ashes even spilled, %player_name%. The kings can rest.
Ogre stew will taste different now.
1020000001201: Stay out of the berry thickets unless you want a nasty bite.
Snakes. A warm spring brought them out early, and the bushes are full of them.
Four of our foragers have been bitten this week, and the berries are rotting on the vine.
Clear out ten snakes, and the foragers can get back to work.
Watch your ankles in the thickets. Come back when %count% are dead.
Have %count% %name%s been dealt with yet? Another forager got bitten.
The foragers are filling their baskets again, %player_name%. Thank you, truly.
1020000001202: I keep antivenom for snakebites, in little vials drying on a rack by the cave.
Last night the bats swooped down and carried off every shiny vial on the rack.
Yes, and with this many snakes about, someone will need it before long.
Knock down the bats and bring me back five vials. Lives depend on it.
The bats roost by the cave mouth. Bring back %count% vials, unbroken.
Do you have the %count% %name%s yet? Another forager is limping.
Five vials, not a crack in them, %player_name%! The foragers are safe now.
1020000001301: The woodcutters won't use the north road any more.
Goblin raiders hide in the ferns along the road and jump out at every cart.
They've taken axes, saws and two oxen. The lumber camp is close to starving.
Hit them back. Ten raiders down, and the rest will think twice.
They hide in the ferns beside the road. Come back when %count% are down.
Have %count% %name%s been dealt with yet? Another cart was robbed.
The carts are rolling again, and nobody's been ambushed in days, %player_name%. Well done.
Tell them to oil their wheels.
1020000001302: When the goblins first attacked, the ranger at the watchtower ran for his life.
He dropped the tower keys in the ferns, right on top of a snake nest.
They coil round anything cold and shiny. Every snake in that nest is hoarding a key.
Bring me five keys and we can man the watchtower again.
The snakes near the tower have the keys. I need %count% of them.
Do you have the %count% %name%s yet? The tower is still dark.
Five keys, %player_name%! The watchtower's lantern will be lit tonight.
Tell the ranger not to run so fast next time.
1020000001601: Do you see the apple orchard behind the inn? It's crawling with snakes.
They come for the fallen apples, then for the mice that eat the apples.
Now nobody can pick fruit, and the cider press has gone quiet.
Clear out ten of them, and the harvest can go ahead.
Check under the trees with the most windfall. Come back after %count%.
Have %count% %name%s been cleared yet? The apples are going to waste.
The pickers are back in the trees, %player_name%! There'll be cider this year after all.
1020000001602: I'm the town tanner. Adventurers sell me monster claws, and I turn them into charms and buckles.
Rats broke into my storeroom and dragged every claw down into the drains.
What would rats want with claws?
